notes: Manifest v102 repairs two Mask regressions observed on Android Chat. Same-tab canonical account-state adoption now updates the live Chat state directly instead of synthesizing a browser storage event that caused broad storage listeners and full-mask rerender behavior on every send. Closed native dialogs are explicitly contained so Bridge settings/runtime diagnostic text cannot bleed into or intercept taps in the conversation viewport. Server/account and LALM authority are unchanged.
